title: Elasticsearch is reachable without signing in
summary: The Elasticsearch HTTP API answers unauthenticated, which exposes and lets an attacker read or change the indexed data.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("You Know, for Search") or (body_contains("cluster_name") and body_contains("cluster_uuid"))) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Put Elasticsearch behind authentication and off the public internet.
